(NYSE:HD) has risen 19.42% since June 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.85% the S&P500.

(NYSE:PEP) by 96,000 shares to 134,400 shares, valued at $14.67M in 2018Q1, according to the filing.
